metadata.name: AccountCreation
metadata.description: Use this API to create account in the CoreCARD platform. New accounts are created for a specific product . The API captures required personal information for the account holder , including address and  shipping information.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountCreationMethod
request_fields.description: Indicates the account creation methods. There are 2 methods for account creation. This tag value is not considered for the multi wallet products. Valid values : 0= With Load 1= Without Load Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: BranchCode
request_fields.description: Branch code from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1006 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example:1511 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: LinkWithExistingAccountFlag
request_fields.description: Flag to link with existing Account Number. Valid Values: 0 = No 1 = Yes Example: 1 This field is not supported for Virtual Gift Card product. Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: LinkedAccountNumber
request_fields.description: To link an account with an existing account in the system. Valid values : Existing Account Number Example : 60000000009719 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: LoadAmount
request_fields.description: Use to post the amount of Load on the cardholder account. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 100.50 Condition: It is mandatory when AccountCreationMethod tag  is '0' (With Load). Additionally for the multi wallet products, this tag will be bypassed.

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title for the customer Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Section : Title Values Example: Mr. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Andrew Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid values : A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Charles Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid values : A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Hudson Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid Values:  A-Z, a-z and all special characters Example: Hudson M Charles Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values: 0-9 Example:- 03/26/1986 Condition: It is Mandatory when Card Account Parameters is Set as Yes on Product.

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Condition: Optional for Virtual Gift Card product; mandatory for all other product types. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: DifferentShipToAddress
request_fields.description: Decision flag to decides address to ship a card. Valid Values: 0 = Ship To Card holder Address (Default) 1 = Ship To Office Address 2 = Ship To Other Address Example: 2 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: ShipToFirstName
request_fields.description: First Name  for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: TestName Condition :It is mandatory when DifferentShipToAddress =1 and 2 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToMiddleName
request_fields.description: Middle Name  for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: MName Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToLastName
request_fields.description: Last Name  for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: LastName Condition :It is mandatory when DifferentShipToAddress =1 and 2 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 Meca Way Condition :It is mandatory when DifferentShipToAddress =1 and 2 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToCity
request_fields.description: City for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:Norcross Condition :It is mandatory when DifferentShipToAddress =1 and 2 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ShipToPostalCode
request_fields.description: ZIP code for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Condition :It is mandatory when DifferentShipToAddress =1 and 2 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ShipToCountry
request_fields.description: Country Code for Shipping address Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: US Condition:It is mandatory when value of DifferentShipToAddress =1 and 2 Refer Appendix Section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: ShipToState
request_fields.description: State for Shipping address Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:NY Condition:It is mandatory when value of DifferentShipToAddress =1 and 2 Refer Appendix Section: State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: EmailAddress1
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 1 of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: [email protected] Condition: If the validation parameter is set on the product for Primary Email Address then it will be mandatory. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: EmailAddress2
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 2 of Card holder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @. Example : [email protected] Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of Card Holder Valid Value:0-9 Ex: 123456789 Condition: 1. This tag is mandatory for product having ID required as "Yes". 2. At least one of SocialSecurityNumber or IDName field should be passed in the input as Identification details. 3.Optional for Virtual Gift Card product. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: IDName
request_fields.description: IDName represents Name of ID Valid Values: 0-9 Example 05 Condition: 1.This tag is mandatory for product having ID required as "Yes". 2.At least one of SocialSecurityNumber or IDName field should be passed in the input as Identification details Refer Appendix section :  ID Name Values 3.Optional for Virtual Gift Card product. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: IDNumber
request_fields.description: Last 4 Digits of Primary ID Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 4586 Condition: This field is mandatory when IDName = '01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','12','13'. Allowable Values: 18

request_fields.name: IDDescription
request_fields.description: Description of ID Valid Values: A-Z,a-z, 0-9. Condition: Field will be ignored in case of ID Name other than '13 - Other ID'. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: IDIssueCountry
request_fields.description: ID Issuing Country Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Condition : Mandatory when IDName in (2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12,13) Appendix Section:Refer Appendix Section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: IDIssueState
request_fields.description: ID Issue State Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:GA Condition:This field is mandatory when IDName = '02', '07' and Country = US Appendix Section: Refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: IDIssueDate
request_fields.description: ID Issue Date Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example: 03/26/1998 Condition: This field is mandatory when IDName= '02' and IDIssueCountry = 'US' and IDIssueState is other than 'MA','MO','MI','TX'

request_fields.name: IDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Expiration date of ID. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example:03/26/1998

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Home Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769 Condition: It is Mandatory when Card Account Parameters is Set as Yes on Product. Note: At least one of HomePhoneNumber, WorkPhoneNumber or MobilePhoneNumber tag is needed when Phone number required is set as ‘Yes’. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder  Work Phone Number Valid values:0-9 Example:9632581470 Condition: It is Mandatory when Card Account Parameters is Set as Yes on Product. Note: At least one of HomePhoneNumber, WorkPhoneNumber or MobilePhoneNumber tag is needed when Phone number required is set as ‘Yes’. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Condition: It is Mandatory when Card Account Parameters is Set as Yes on Product. Note: At least one of HomePhoneNumber, WorkPhoneNumber or MobilePhoneNumber tag is needed when Phone number required is set as ‘Yes’. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: HomeFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder Home Fax Number Valid values are 0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WorkFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Work Fax Number Valid values: 0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IsCardMasked
request_fields.description: Flag to indicate CardNumber should be returned in masked form or in clear form. Valid Values: 0= Card Number without Masked in Resonse. 1= Card Number with Masked in Resonse. 2= No Card Number in Resonse. Note : Default value is 0 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: CreateCIPFailedAccount
request_fields.description: Action to be taken when CIP check is failed Possible value are 'Y' and 'N' Y- Create Account N- Do not create Account Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: LinkWithExistingCustomer
request_fields.description: To link new account with existing customer using customer ID Valid Values: 0 = No(default) and 1 = Yes Format: x Example: 0=No, This field is not supported for Virtual Gift Card product.

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Condition: Mandatory when 'Link With Existing Customer' = Yes Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: HoldEmbossing
request_fields.description: Tag to decide physical card or virtual card by holding embossing file. Valid Values: 0 - No (Physical card) 1 - Yes (Virtual card)

request_fields.name: WalletID
request_fields.description: Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

request_fields.name: WalletLoadAmount
request_fields.description: Amount To Be Collected or Wallet Load Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11

request_fields.name: EmbossingLine4
request_fields.description: Text to be printed on Line 4 of a plastic. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, ,-./'$ Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: PlasticCode
request_fields.description: Plastic Code Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 32 Allowable Values: 100

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001

children.name: DDANumber
children.description: DDA (Direct Deposit Account) which can be used in ACH transactions. Valid values : 0-9 Example:1234567890

children.name: ABANumber
children.description: Destination Routing and Transit number of institution.

children.name: UserID
children.description: UserID Example:AdminUser

children.name: DerivedStatus
children.description: Status which is derived by considering Card Status (manual and generated), account status (manual and generated) and Card plastic status Example: Active

children.name: CardExpirationDate
children.description: Expiration Date of the card. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Valid Values: 0-9,'/'. Example: 2021-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: CVC
children.description: Three digit printed on  the back of  the card. Valid Values - 0-9 Example: 213

children.name: CardExpirationDateISO
children.description: Expiration Date of created card as per ISO format. Format: MMYY Example: 0121

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123

children.name: LNResultsGroup
children.description: LNResultsGroup

children.name: NASCheckValue
children.description: Name Address SSN (NAS) Check tag shows Reason Codes which is being triggered on the card Example: 10 Input First name, Address, and SSN matched

children.name: LexNexList
children.description: This will have RiskCodes in Array

children.name: RiskCodes
children.description: Risk Codes triggered on the card Example: 28 Unable to verify date-of-birth

children.name: CVICheckValue
children.description: score of Comprehensive Verification Index Example: 0,10,20

children.name: LexNexInquiryDate
children.description: Lexis Nexis Inquiry Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: OFACResultsGroup
children.description: OFACResultsGroup

children.name: OFACInquiryDate
children.description: OFAC Inquiry Date Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: OFACScore
children.description: Score received after OFAC Checks. Example : 2

children.name: SDNEntry1
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry2
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry3
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry4
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: SDNEntry5
children.description: Value imposed to an Account after OFAC Check via third party Example:85

children.name: PlasticCode
children.description: Plastic Code of Card Valid Values: a to z, A to Z, 0 to 9 Example:- Chicksaw Nation Grant Card - Clothing (50)
